title: BG rising or falling fast alarms do not work
symptom: The high or low alarms show up on the phone and the watch, but the other alarms like BG rising or falling fast do not seem to work. It only worked once when first set up, and reinstalling xdrip+ and reconnecting the blucon did not help.
evidence_quote: The high or low alarms both show up on the phone and the watch, but the other alarms like BG rising or falling fast do not seem to work.
